tasks.label: gamecore-tests
tasks.command: export PATH=/opt/swift/usr/bin:$PATH && cd /workspaces/gameforge/Packages/GameCore && swift test 2>&1 | tail -60

tasks.label: swiftlint
tasks.command: export PATH=/opt/swift/usr/bin:$PATH && export LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/opt/swift/usr/lib/swift/linux:$LD_LIBRARY_PATH && cd /workspaces/gameforge && swiftlint --config .swiftlint.yml 2>&1 | tail -10

tasks.label: self-review-diff
tasks.command: cd /workspaces/gameforge && git show HEAD -- Packages/GameCore | head -600

tasks.label: git-inspect
tasks.command: cd /workspaces/gameforge && git log --oneline -8 && echo '---' && git status --porcelain=v1 && echo '---' && git show --stat HEAD | head -30

tasks.label: commit-review-fixes
tasks.command: cd /workspaces/gameforge && git add -A && git commit -m 'Address Task 10 review: 10x guarantee, gear inventory, encapsulation, idle persistence' && git log --oneline -1
